description: Year-end series used to express the dollar outcome of each qualifying investment route. Index levels and rates as published by the sources named; the dollar conversion is done by the consumer using the fx series. Published so that the site tool, the connector and this dataset compute from the same numbers. Not investment advice and not an investable product: gross of taxes, fund fees and transaction costs.
note: The 2026 values are partial-year, to 6 November 2026.

gold.label: Gold held in lira, gram price
gold.note: The series stops at 2025. An entry year at or after the last value is an absence of data, not a zero return.
gold.sourceNote: Source publication not yet recorded. See openQuestions in sources.json.

tlDep.label: Rolling Turkish lira deposits, realised annual return

usdDep.label: US dollar deposit in a Turkish bank, annual return

housing.label: Housing: TCMB price index growth plus about 5 per cent rental yield

qualifying.note: Only some of these are qualifying investments. Direct personal stock portfolios and physical gold do not qualify; a real estate or venture capital investment fund (GYF or GSYF) is the compliant wrapper for equity exposure.

sourceRegister: Not yet in sources.json. The index levels and rates here are attributed in each series' source field, but none has a dated register entry with a URL, so a citation of this file cannot be traced the way a citation of investment-thresholds.json can.
